svg.text: A static front end, one backend, and a handful of small functions for the things that need secrets.
HOW THE APP GETS TO YOU
Everything is built ahead of time. There is no application server.
Once the page is open, the browser talks straight to the backend.
caches the site so it still
embeds and analytics load straight into the page
Four questions cover almost every task.
I want to add a new page
I want to add a UI component
I want to add a table, column, or policy
I want to add anything using a secret key
I want to add a blog post
1 — There is no server of ours.
Anything dynamic is either the Supabase backend
or one of the Edge Functions.
The login screens and “admin only” checks in the UI are
convenience. Row-Level Security is the real lock.
If code needs an API secret, it belongs in an
Edge Function, not in the React app.
Simplified view for onboarding — drawn from TortoiseWolfe/ScriptHammer @ main. The four-plate reference diagram has the full detail.
